## The Data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GAStech_nodes <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_node.csv")
GAStech_edges <- read_csv("data/GAStech_email_edge-v2.csv")
```
:::




Two checks: 
-   all date and time should be numerical fields.
-   sentDate is not clear. it is now character type.

## Data Wrangling



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GAStech_edges <- GAStech_edges %>%
  mutate(SendDate = dmy(SentDate)) %>% #send vs sent
  mutate(Weekday = wday(SentDate, # Derive weekday field
                        label = TRUE,
                        abbr = FALSE))
```
:::




## Wrangling attributes (edges)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>%
  filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>%
  group_by(source, target, Weekday) %>%
    summarise(Weight = n()) %>%
  filter(source!=target) %>% # Filter sel away
  filter(Weight > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```
:::



## Using tbl_graph() to build tidygraph data model




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
GAStech_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = GAStech_nodes,
                           edges = GAStech_edges_aggregated, 
                           directed = TRUE)
```
:::
